question: Which Stellar SCF RFPs or submission opportunities are open right now?

golden.answer: Call the live open-RFP view, list only returned open rows, cite each brief URL, and include `meta.scfRound` as-of, phase, deadline, and `verifyAt` when present. Cross-check brief status against the official SCF RFP Track page; attribute and date each roster, and flag a returned brief that the official page no longer lists. Separate synthetic `scf-round` rows from curated briefs. Distinguish published open briefs from a confirmed open SCF submission round. Do not infer full-proposal availability from brief status alone.
keyFacts: Lists only briefs that the live open-RFP response or official RFP page supports.
Includes source links and current round as-of/phase/deadline/verifyAt.
Treats curated sponsor briefs and the official SCF submission round as distinct.
Cross-checks brief status against the official RFP Track page or flags it unverified.
avoid: Do NOT claim an open brief proves application availability when no Submission phase is open.
Do NOT call Q2 2026 RFP briefs open now.
Claims that an open brief proves the current SCF round accepts a new full proposal.
Do NOT call a Scout-listed brief open now unless the answer attributes and dates that status.
golden.notes: Freshness item: As of 2026-11-05, the official RFP Track page lists no open brief and says "October 2026: New Q4 RFPs are coming soon." Scout now agrees: open=0, activeQuarter=q4-2026, both former Q3 briefs closed. Its separate synthetic scf-round-46 row describes the Submission window through 2026-11-09; it is not an RFP brief. Grade dated source-relative roster reporting, not a permanent absence claim. Re-query later sources and flag any new disagreement. A historical, attributed report of the former Q3 rows is acceptable; it is not current evidence that those briefs are open. Reporting no open brief meets the listing fact; a synthetic round must not be substituted for one. The awards page showed November 8 in a 2026-10-18 snapshot, and older community posts repeat it; do not penalize a dated, attributed historical November 8 citation.
